description: Implementation conditions scored on the shared held-out set. Only C0 exists today: the deterministic governed pipeline. C1 (retrieval-assisted) and C2 (bounded tool-using agent) are deliberately absent rather than stubbed, because a condition that cannot run is not a condition and would make the report look comparative when it is not.

conditions.description: The existing governed deterministic pipeline, wrapped not rebuilt. Makes no provider call by construction.
